body.text: Research start: 2026-11-03 03:22:24 UTC (date -u). Eight-hour operator budget; first reconstruction has a 60-minute deadline. I will reconstruct the three toss/catch events and in-hand spins, explicitly mark unobservable ball rotation, record criteria before judging a policy, then build a physically simulated right Wuji hand and train a closed-loop network using RL. No target-environment or other-agent records are used.

Task decomposition from direct video inspection: initial hold and downward wrist preparation; release around frame53, capture67; in-hand spin/regrasp through163; release164, capture178; next spin/regrasp through200; release201, capture217; final in-hand spin and hold to314. TODO: verify contact transitions and wrist pose in MANO reconstruction; learn launch/capture; learn rotation while supported; compose three launches with the instructed intervening spins. Sphere diameter anchors scale. Independent quadratic fits to segmented free flights give camera accelerations roughly (-0.08,8.54,3.87), (-0.19,8.87,3.68), (-0.23,7.87,3.08) m/s^2, so a tilted gravity direction is necessary. Ball rotational phase is unobservable.

Operator update read from README: hard stop2026-11-03 11:22 UTC, regardless of outcome. Reserve the closing interval for best-policy verification and final reflection. Before that, continue through failed iterations until recorded criteria pass. Current stage remains reconstruction validation; no robot training simulation has been built.

body.text: Simulation r0008 validated specified masses/inertia/controllers. Direct retargeted wrist replay with naive finger synergies loses the ball; a palm-up upward stroke produces ballistic rises up to0.18m but capture rebounds and lateral drift remain. Begin PPO residual RL (closed-loop network; actions22 wrist/finger synergy residuals) over a2s launch/catch curriculum,64 parallel MuJoCo environments. Base reference and kinematic interception guide exploration; only the learned network-plus-residual policy will be reported, not these analysis controllers. Next curriculum will add supported rotation and three-cycle composition.

Second PPO run changes exploration and policy smoothing only: initial Gaussian logstd-1.5 versus-0.8 and100ms residual smoothing(alpha0.2 at50Hz). Early training episodes survive about52steps versus17steps in the unsmoothed run and occasionally generate qualifying flights. This is a policy change within simulation v1, not altered physics. Both evaluated runs will be recorded with checkpoints, curves, three views and full-criteria failures or successes.

Physics diagnosis before further training: vendor URDF convex meshes create persistent palm-to-MCP-abduction housing overlaps(about1.3mm), mechanically adjacent parts separated by the two-axis MCP chain. Those joint-bearing hull contacts push ring/little fingers away from their intended targets and destabilize a seemingly settled grip. Stopped own PPO jobs with preserved checkpoints; both will be evaluated and recorded in their original simulation v1. Build simulation v2 with explicit exclusions only for these mechanical neighbor bodies, keeping all ball-hand and inter-finger collisions. No hand mass, joint limits or actuation limits change.

body.text: Both original-simulation policies failed0/12 complete episodes under criteria v2 (r0012/r0013). A reset stability test exposed a second controller defect: target rate limiting used a world-frame rotation vector in MuJoCo's local quaternion-integrate operation, causing spurious wrist rotation when target differed from current orientation. Corrected by rotating the increment into target-local coordinates before integration; world-frame feedforward and torque error remain as specified. The old binaries are preserved with simv1/v2. Corrected simv3 holds ball stationary10s after reset and must pass wrist tests before training. Simv2's recorded1.16m drift is a failed diagnostic, not a validation pass.

body.text: Stopping on passing self-verification r0026 at2026-11-03 04:14 UTC, before the11:22 UTC hard limit. Final iteration r0025: closed-loop residual PPO,524288 transitions,12/12 held-out episodes satisfy operative criteria v2: three toss/catches,three supported spins,1s final hold, no losses or finger-hardware violations. Flights7.0–9.2cm/0.24–0.28s; spin integrals1.80–2.71rad; wrist RMS4.74cm/31.5deg; palm-up100%.
